note.title: github recon & leaked secrets
note.intro: github e uma das maiores fontes de vazamento de credenciais e informacao interna. devs commitem api keys, configs, dockerfiles com endpoints internos, e ate .env em repo publico. dois vetores principais: (1) code search no github por secrets/endpoints do alvo, (2) .git exposto no web server do proprio alvo.
commands:
# via site:github.com (google)
site:github.com "alvo.com"
site:github.com "alvo.com" "api_key"
site:github.com "alvo.com" "password"
site:github.com "alvo.com" ".env"
site:github.com "alvo.com" "aws_secret"
site:github.com "alvo.com" filename:docker-compose.yml
site:github.com "alvo.com" filename:.env

# github code search direto (precisa login)
# https://github.com/search?q=%22alvo.com%22+password&type=code
# https://github.com/search?q=org%3Aalvo+AKIA&type=code

# search code autenticado
gh search code "alvo.com" --limit 100
gh search code "org:alvocorp api_key"
gh search code "org:alvocorp password"
gh search code "org:alvocorp AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
gh search code "alvo.com extension:env"

# search repos
gh search repos --owner alvocorp
gh repo list alvocorp --limit 100

# commits com secrets
gh api "repos/alvocorp/repo_name/commits" | jq -r '.[].commit.message'

# projectdiscovery
github-subdomains -d alvo.com -t $GITHUB_TOKEN -o gh_subs.txt

# gitdorks_go
gitDorks_go -t $GITHUB_TOKEN -d alvo.com -gw gitDorks.txt

# gists publicos
gh gist list --public
# buscar gists por dominio
curl -s "https://api.github.com/search/code?q=alvo.com+extension:py" \
  -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" | jq -r '.items[].html_url'

# gitlab
curl -s "https://gitlab.com/api/v4/search?scope=blobs&search=alvo.com" | jq -r '.[].data'
curl -s "https://gitlab.com/api/v4/search?scope=projects&search=alvo" | jq -r '.[].path_with_namespace'

# travis-ci configs (historico)
curl -s "https://api.travis-ci.org/repos/alvocorp" | jq -r '.[].slug'

# scan repo
trufflehog github --org=alvocorp --token=$GITHUB_TOKEN

# scan repo especifico
trufflehog github --repo=https://github.com/alvocorp/repo_name

# scan filesystem
trufflehog filesystem /path/to/downloaded_code

# scan git history (importante: secret removido em commit ainda existe no history)
trufflehog git https://github.com/alvocorp/repo_name --json

# scan repo
gitleaks detect --source=https://github.com/alvocorp/repo_name --report-path=leaks.json

# scan org (precisa config)
gitleaks detect --source=. --config=github_org.toml

# scan git history
gitleaks detect --source=. --log-opts="--all" --report-path=history_leaks.json

# scan org inteira
gitrob --github-access-token=$GITHUB_TOKEN alvocorp

# salva em db
gitrob --no-banner --commit alvocorp -dump

# verificar se .git/ esta acessivel
curl -s https://alvo.com/.git/HEAD
# saida esperada se exposto: ref: refs/heads/master

curl -s https://alvo.com/.git/config
curl -sI https://alvo.com/.git/

# ffuf pra variacoes
ffuf -u https://alvo.com/FUZZ -w git_wordlist.txt -mc 200
# wordlist: .git, .git/, .git/HEAD, .git/config, .git/index, .git/logs/HEAD

# git-dumper (baixa o repo inteiro via http)
python3 git_dumper.py https://alvo.com/.git/ alvo_git/

# ou via wget manual
mkdir alvo_git && cd alvo_git
wget -r -nH --cut-dirs=1 --no-parent https://alvo.com/.git/

# restaurar estado
git log --oneline
git status
git checkout -- .  # restaura working tree
git log --all --oneline  # todos os commits
git diff HEAD~5 HEAD  # ver mudancas recentes

#!/bin/bash
ORG=$1        # alvocorp
DOMAIN=$2     # alvo.com
OUTDIR="recon/$DOMAIN/github"
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"

echo "[*] repos da org..."
gh repo list "$ORG" --limit 200 --json name,url -o "$OUTDIR/repos.json"
echo "[+] $(jq '. | length' "$OUTDIR/repos.json") repos"

echo "[*] code search..."
for query in "api_key" "secret" "password" "aws_secret" "BEGIN RSA" "extension:env" "firebase"; do
  echo "[*] query: $query"
  gh search code "org:$ORG $query" --limit 100 >> "$OUTDIR/code_search.txt" 2>/dev/null
done
sort -u "$OUTDIR/code_search.txt" -o "$OUTDIR/code_search.txt"

echo "[*] trufflehog em cada repo..."
jq -r '.[].url' "$OUTDIR/repos.json" | while read repo; do
  trufflehog github --repo="$repo" --json 2>/dev/null >> "$OUTDIR/trufflehog.json"
done

echo "[*] subdominios via github..."
github-subdomains -d "$DOMAIN" -t "$GITHUB_TOKEN" -o "$OUTDIR/gh_subs.txt" 2>/dev/null

echo "[*] .git exposto..."
cat "../live.txt" 2>/dev/null | while read url; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$url/.git/HEAD")
  if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then
    echo "[!] .git exposed: $url" >> "$OUTDIR/git_exposed.txt"
  fi
done

echo "[+] $(jq -s 'length' "$OUTDIR/trufflehog.json" 2>/dev/null) secrets via trufflehog"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/code_search.txt") code hits"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/gh_subs.txt") subs via github"

results de code search so aparecem autenticado. usar gh search code ou curl com $GITHUB_TOKEN no header. google dorks funcionam sem login mas cobrem menos
gitlab publico e menos varrido que github. muitas empresas tem mirror la e vazam secrets que github ja teria achado. sempre checar gitlab alem do github
remover secret em commit novo nao resolve — git history e imutavel. trufflehog git --all ou gitleaks --log-opts="--all" acham chaves em commits antigos. reportavel mesmo se o arquivo atual nao tem
